data.name: Gurudutt
data.long_meaning: The name Gurudutt is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Guru’ meaning ‘teacher’ and ‘Dutt’ meaning ‘servant’ or ‘learner’. This name signifies one who is a devoted learner, especially of spiritual truths. In Hindu mythology, the term ‘Guru’ is used to denote a spiritual teacher or guide who imparts wisdom and knowledge to his students.
